name: BRUNO DE SEDA
description: Bruno de Seda presents a 60-minute concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto.
longDescription:
Bruno de Seda performs a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto on 5 December 2026. The performance starts at 22:00 and runs for 60 minutes.

General admission tickets are 8€ in advance, or 10€ at the door. The concert is open to attendees aged 16 and older.
